suites.title: Test Writing
suites.description: Add meaningful tests to an existing codebase while preserving the public contract.
suites.evaluation: Hidden regression tests, mutation score, and patch validity.

suites.title: Refactoring
suites.description: Improve structure, readability, or performance without changing observable behavior.
suites.evaluation: Regression suite, static checks, behavior equivalence, and patch quality.

suites.title: Codebase Q&A
suites.description: Answer questions about a real repository with file-and-line grounded evidence.
suites.evaluation: Reference answer agreement plus citation and repository-grounding checks.

suites.title: Bug Fixing
suites.description: Diagnose and fix an issue in a repository without breaking unrelated behavior.
suites.evaluation: Hidden reproducer, regression tests, and changed-surface checks.
